name: Count Fingers’ fishbowl
role: Scene 1 — foreground glass vessel for Count Fingers, separate from its stand
dimension_contract: dimensions_m describes the complete empty upright glass bowl and attached brass base collar, excluding water, fish and stand. The 0.52 m maximum diameter is retained from the engine; 0.44 m height is a new provisional art target matching the approved bulbous silhouette, not a measurement of the existing 0.52 × 0.26 × 0.52 m hemisphere primitive. Use the stated 0.52 × 0.44 × 0.52 m dimensions to author the engine geometry; the painted profile envelopes are not exact CAD dimensions. The sheet presents the bowl sideways, reconstruction box 0.52W × 0.52H × 0.44D m, with its opening toward +Z. Rotate -90 degrees about X to return it upright before checking bounds and grounding the closed base. This is a shape/construction reference, not a transparency texture. Engine-built transparent glass remains the intended route; Tripo reconstruction is not required.

alignment_guide.method: New precise orthographic diagram drawn with matplotlib Agg, not an edit or manipulation of generated image pixels.
alignment_guide.purpose: Measured silhouette guide used as input to built-in imagegen, not delivered as final art.

assembly.method: Unchanged repository cutter: crop and translate onto native equal square panels with shared baseline; no per-view scaling or raster retouching.

object_scope.rule: Model the object only, never a dressed arrangement.
object_scope.contents: One empty glass bowl with its attached brass base collar.

design.structure: Bulbous transparent glass vessel with a broad open mouth, thick rolled lip, closed glass bottom and compact attached brass base collar.
design.front: Looking directly into the open circular mouth, with lip thickness and the interior bowl/base surface visible.
design.left: Sideways profile, mouth on image-right and brass base collar on image-left.
design.right: Opposite sideways profile, mouth on image-left and brass base collar on image-right.
design.back: Exterior closed glass bottom encircled by the brass base collar; not a second mouth.
design.finish: Clear pale cool-tinted glass with broad illustrative highlights, and warm worn brass with chunky rivets. Glass cues are a material reference, not albedo or opacity data.
design.cavity: Open mouth and closed bottom; not a geometric through-hole. Transparent pixels or painted reflections alone do not establish hollow mesh topology.
design.separate_stand: The brass collar belongs to the bowl. The turned wooden bowl_stand remains a separate asset in the engine queue.

reconstruction_orientation.status: Proposed reference convention; no new mesh generated or engine transform applied.
reconstruction_orientation.fixed_object_pose: Sideways, mouth toward +Z, closed base toward -Z
reconstruction_orientation.axis_convention: Right-handed: +Y up on the sheet, +X right, opening axis +Z.
reconstruction_orientation.upright_axis_mapping: Reconstruction +Z becomes engine +Y; reconstruction +Y becomes engine -Z; reconstruction +X remains engine +X.
reconstruction_orientation.grounding: After rotation, place the closed base at y=0. If the origin is the reconstruction bounding-box center, add +0.22 m along engine Y. Recheck the imported mesh’s actual axes and bounds first.
reconstruction_orientation.dimension_rule: Fit uniformly; do not stretch model axes or independently resize image views.

placement.convention_status: Approved placement direction only; final pedestal coordinates remain engine work.
placement.target_location: Foreground left, on the separate bowl_stand so Count Fingers is readable in exploration.
placement.origin: Closed base centered on the stand’s support surface
placement.placement_note: The old desk position is documented for comparison, not proposed as the new placement.

framing.projection: Level orthographic front, opposite profiles and back
framing.camera: Horizontal optical axis at the midpoint of the fixed sideways object; zero pitch and roll.
framing.scale: All four raw-source and final silhouettes are exactly 485 px high. Native crops were translated only; no view was scaled.

validation.status: source framing measured; engine geometry and materials remain unverified

visual_review.view_construction: Open-mouth front, opposite edge-on profiles and closed-bottom back; mouth points image-right in left profile and image-left in right profile. A brass collar surrounds only the closed base.
visual_review.style: Selected guide-based pass uses clean outlines and broad cel-shaded glass/brass shapes, with less photographic reflection detail than the earlier attempts.
visual_review.isolation: Four whole, separate objects on plain white; no fish, water, stand, floor shadow, labels or scenery.
visual_review.opening: Thick rolled mouth and recessed inner floor are depicted; the back is closed. This is a construction illustration and does not verify a hollow mesh.
visual_review.material: Pale glass fill and graphic highlights identify the material; retain actual transparent glass in engine rather than baking this image into opacity.

limitations: The 0.44 m upright height is a provisional new art target; it differs from the current hemisphere primitive.
Illustrated glass reflections and pale tint are not a physically consistent optical simulation, usable opacity map or proof of wall topology. Preserve transparent glass in engine.
The bowl is closed at the base and does not require a through-hole. Water, Count Fingers and the stand are separately built assets.

Final front/back envelope ratios are 1.000000, 0.997938; opposite profile ratios are 0.878351, 0.880412, versus the nominal 0.846154. These profiles are about 3.81–4.05% wider than the target ratio, including the lip, collar and outline. Author the engine mesh from dimensions_m instead of treating painted pixel bounds as exact geometry.
validation.method: Read-only NumPy/Pillow bounds using the unchanged repository cutter’s modal_colour, ink_mask and find_figures at tolerance 18. Bounds are [x0,y0,x1,y1] with upper bounds exclusive. Final visual review separately checks presentation and design, not mesh topology.
validation.foreground_threshold: Sum of absolute RGB distance from modal background exceeds 54.

pipeline.intended_route: Engine-built transparent glass mesh, using this sheet as shape/construction reference
pipeline.view_extraction: Optional reference inspection; use named gap-detected views and one common canvas
pipeline.upload_note: If reconstruction is later requested, assign images by their named view; sheet display order is not positional upload order.
pipeline.material_note: Retain transparent inner/outer glass shell treatment and separate water/fish. Do not bake the illustrated highlights or pale blue-gray body fill into the engine opacity or water geometry.
pipeline.next_step: Use the final reference to refine the engine’s bowl silhouette and brass collar, fit the separate stand and confirm Count Fingers remains readable through the glass. No automatic replacement of the existing primitive route is implied.
pipeline.recommended_crop_command: python tools/crop_views.py art/props/fishbowl/sheet.png --row 0 1 --names front left right back --pad 0.12 --size 601 --out art/props/fishbowl/views

pipeline.upscale_note: Native view canvases are 601 px square. A common 1202 px export meets the documented post-upscale minimum if image reconstruction is later requested, but adds no source detail. Gap detection avoids padding the existing equal cells again.
